questions.stem: Which of the following is a profession that people in the defence services can have?

questions.solution: Thannamandi is the correct answer because it is the specific village name associated with Wahida's birthplace. Rajouri is a district, Jammu is a city, and Kashmir is a larger region, none of which refer to the exact location of her birth.

hi.stem: वह गाँव का नाम क्या है जहाँ वहीदा का जन्म हुआ था?
